item.title: Mondrian 1.26.0
item.description:
A studio rail gives Mondrian its own place beside the drawing workspace.

  • Mondrian's logo stays in a slim, persistent rail beside the Library and canvas. Rail buttons show or hide Library, open the Stencil Editor, and open Settings.
  • Collapsing Library gives the drawing more space while keeping its selection, pending edits, and inspector. Search Library restores the sidebar and focuses search.
  • The title bar identifies the app as Mondrian. The drawing name appears once beneath the ribbon, with its folder path, component count, connections, and current save.
  • The Library starts with its search and folder outline instead of a large app logo. The ribbon retains its common height, inline layout settings, individual connector types, and bend controls in De Stijl and Chalk.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.25.2
item.description:
An Office-style ribbon keeps the drawing steady as you switch tabs.

  • Shapes, Connectors, Layout, and Display now share one fixed ribbon height. The drawing title and canvas stay in place when you change tabs or layout algorithms.
  • Related commands sit in equal-height groups with captions along the bottom and vertical separators. Main tools use large labelled icons; smaller controls occupy up to three rows.
  • All layout settings remain inline. Page, canvas, spacing, balance, alignment, APM bands, containers, and flow controls are grouped to fit the common ribbon grid. Narrow windows retain scrolling and navigation arrows.
  • De Stijl and Chalk, individual connector types, bend editing, automatic previews, and Save Version continue to work.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.25.1
item.description:
A ribbon above the drawing title puts layout controls directly within reach.

  • The Shapes, Connectors, Layout, and Display tabs now have icons, and the ribbon sits above the drawing title.
  • Layout shows presets, algorithms, page size, orientation, canvas size, header spacing, and every setting for the current algorithm inline. Use typed values, steppers, pickers, and checkboxes; changes preview automatically and Save Version keeps them.
  • Scroll horizontally through layout groups in smaller windows. Balanced nesting, APM bands, flex flow, grids, treemaps, and free-form layouts show their own relevant controls in De Stijl and Chalk.
  • Selecting a placed connector still reveals its individual type and bend controls in the Connectors tab.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.25.0
item.description:
A drawing ribbon brings Shapes, Connectors, Layout, and Display together beneath the title.

  • Switch ribbon tabs for shape tools and stencil editing, connector types and bends, layout algorithms and presets, or display and canvas settings. The ribbon adapts to smaller windows and works in De Stijl and Chalk.
  • Click a placed connector to select it, even while the Connect tool is active. The ribbon opens Connectors and highlights that line's type. Choose Smooth, Direct, or Right angle to change only the selected line.
  • Type changes support Undo, Save Version, and reopening. Attachment points, descriptions, and manual bends are retained; other connectors and the drawing default stay as they were. With no line selected, or while creating new lines, the type controls set the drawing default.
  • Existing AI client connections and drawing exports remain compatible.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.24.0
item.description:
Edit right-angle connector routes and find drawing tools together beneath the title.

  • The canvas toolbar groups Select, Shapes, Connect, and Smooth / Direct / Right angle. Its style picker edits the selected line, or sets the default for new lines while connecting. It adapts to narrower windows.
  • Select a right-angle line and click Add Bend, or double-click a segment, to add a detour. Drag the square segment handles to move its corners while keeping every segment horizontal or vertical.
  • Dragging previews the actual route without editing the drawing until release. Escape cancels; each completed edit uses one Undo action.
  • Manual bends survive Save Version, reopening, and all exports. Endpoints stay attached when shapes move or resize. Reset Route restores automatic routing, and the inspector and right-click menu also offer the bend actions.
  • AI clients can read and update manual routes through the existing MCP tools; connection settings remain compatible.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.23.1
item.description:
Add connectors directly in Mondrian with the new Connect tool.

  • Click Connect beside Export, or use Drawing → Connect Shapes (⇧⌘L). Drag from an attachment point on one shape to a point on another.
  • Available points appear on the canvas, with a live routed preview and target snapping. New lines follow the drawing's Smooth, Direct, or Right angle style and keep the chosen endpoints.
  • Connect stays active for adding several lines. Click Done or press Escape to finish; Escape during a drag cancels the preview, and dropping on empty space adds nothing.
  • Each completed drag is one Undo edit. Revert, Save Version, reopening, and exports preserve new connectors without moving the boxes. In drawings with a timeline, new connectors belong to the state shown.

Existing AI client connections continue to work without configuration changes.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.23.0
item.description:
Choose how connectors look and exactly where they attach to each shape.

  • Display offers Smooth, Direct, and Right angle connectors. Click a line to override its style in the inspector, or right-click it for the style menu.
  • Three connection points on every actual polygon edge: 9 on triangles, 12 on diamonds, and 18 on hexagons. Rectangles and curved shapes have 12 points around their outline.
  • Selected connectors show their available points. Drag an endpoint to another point on its shape, with a live route preview, or choose the point in the inspector. Auto spreads connections between points.
  • Undo, Revert, Save Version, reopening, and JSON/PNG/PDF/SVG/HTML exports preserve styles and pinned points. The MCP diagram contract exposes the same choices to AI clients.
  • Clear elbows and corridors route quickly on larger drawings. Smooth and right-angle lines avoid unrelated boxes where possible; direct lines stay straight and report any crossings.

Existing AI client connections continue to work without configuration changes.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.22.2
item.description:
Refines the sidebar spacing and moves the canvas appearance switch into Display.

  • The library search field has balanced spacing below the Mondrian heading, with native search, clear, and keyboard behaviour.
  • In dark mode, open Display and switch Dark canvas on or off to choose a dark or light drawing. Your existing choice is kept.
  • The floating canvas bar contains zoom controls again. Canvas appearance still leaves saved colours and exports unchanged.

Existing AI client connections continue to work without configuration changes.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.22.1
item.description:
Improves selection contrast and lets you choose a light or dark canvas while the app stays in dark mode.

  • Selected library drawings and search results use native contrasting text, fixing dark text on the cobalt highlight in light mode.
  • In dark mode, click Light Canvas or Dark Canvas beside the zoom controls to switch the drawing's appearance. Your choice is remembered.
  • Switching the canvas preserves zoom, selection, and the drawing's original colours in saved files and exports.

Existing AI client connections continue to work without configuration changes.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.22.0
item.description:
Introduces De Stijl light mode and Chalk dark mode, with warm surfaces, geometric branding, and coordinated controls.

  • Choose Light — De Stijl, Dark — Chalk, or Match System in Settings → General → Appearance.
  • Chalk adapts the diagram canvas, labels, connectors, legends, and built-in icons for dark backgrounds while preserving the original colours in saved drawings and exports.
  • Clearer drawing headings and an always-visible Export menu make it easier to work with your diagrams.

Existing AI client connections continue to work without configuration changes.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.21.1
item.description:
Fixes a connection failure that prevented Mondrian's MCP tools from appearing in AI clients.

  • Accept modern clients' experimental capability objects during the MCP handshake.
  • Keep normal tool requests and drawing payloads unchanged.

Restart your AI client after installing this update to reload the helper. The connection is named mondrian-local. Existing configuration entries continue to work; no setup changes are required.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.21.0
item.description:
Connect Mondrian to your AI clients directly from Settings → AI Clients.

  • Add or update Mondrian's local MCP connection in Claude Desktop, ChatGPT / Codex, and Claude Code.
  • See whether each client is configured, missing its connection, or needs an update to the helper path.
  • Preserve other servers and client settings, with a backup before each configuration change.

Install Mondrian in Applications, choose your client in Settings → AI Clients, and click Add Connection or Update Connection. Restart that client to load the change. Claude Code connections use your user configuration and are available across projects.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.

item.title: Mondrian 1.20.0
item.description:
The first release of Mondrian for macOS.

  • A native diagram library, rendering engine, stencil editor, named history, comments, layout presets, and local MCP helper.
  • Mondrian uses its own application identity, setup instructions, and export attribution.
  • Compatible existing libraries remain in their current folders. Saved custom-library locations are inherited without moving or rewriting drawings, history, comments, stencils, presets, or attachments.
  • Missing custom libraries are reported as unavailable instead of being recreated empty.
  • Compatible saved appearance and drawing preferences are imported.

Quit the existing application and your AI clients, remove only the previous application bundle, and drag Mondrian.app into Applications. Keep your library folder and Application Support files. Update each AI client's helper command to Mondrian.app/Contents/MacOS/MondrianMCP and restart the client. Select a library manually with Settings → General → Open Existing Library… if necessary.

Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple silicon. The installer is Developer ID signed and notarised by Apple.
